== Notes ==
* If you invoke this on a non-hostile target (e.g. a [[charmable animal]]), it will turn hostile.
* This skill can also be useful when [[running]]. You are healed and shadow step ahead, escaping from foes and getting closer to your destination.
* Like all spells, this skill has a {{3/4}} second [[aftercast delay]].
* [[Hero]]es will use Death's Charge to close in on foes even if the heal effect isn't needed.
